breaking: Todo updates now require a flat task list rather than nested stages. Existing two-level session snapshots are flattened for display.
features: Search work sessions by title, user messages, assistant messages, or session ID, with matching text previews.
Expand sessions in the session picker to browse user messages and matching results.
Resend a user message on a new branch while preserving the current input draft.
Windows desktop windows now provide custom title bars with drag, minimize, maximize, and close controls. Pages without title-bar integration retain native window decorations.
changed: Branch pickers now remember the selected filter and display branch icons.
Project files and Git status refresh when visible previews open or the window regains focus, with fewer duplicate requests.
Improved file-tree presentation and file-type icons.
Todo progress updates now appear directly in the summary and task list instead of opening a temporary update notice.
Standardized desktop window titles; project-preview titles now show the project name and directory path.
fixed: Empty or loading custom session-header content no longer reserves unnecessary space.
Made Windows process cleanup safer by verifying process identity and ancestry before termination, and handling processes that exit naturally during cleanup.
